_comment: WebPageScreensaver's outbound pins (protocol-instance-split principle 4). A child pins its protocol and its OWN memory repo — and nothing else. There is deliberately no pointer to rhizome-memory or any sibling project: that absence IS the sharing guarantee (a collaborator with this repo can reach WebPageScreensaver's notes and the protocol, never the operator's wider circle). This is a fork of ChayoteJarocho/WebPageScreensaver (upstream remote kept for reference); the governance layer applies only to david-coneff's fork.
